literal_meaning: ছত্রের ভঙ্গ বা ছত্র ভাঙা (umbrella's destruction or breaking of the canopy)
figurative_meaning_en: Destruction of royal insignia or fall of the kingdom
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাজবংশের ছত্রভঙ্গ ঘটল যখন শত্রুরা রাজধানী দখল করল।
এই ঘটনা তার পরিবারের ছত্রভঙ্গ ঘটিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The fall of the dynasty occurred when enemies captured the capital.
This event led to the collapse of their family legacy.
history: In ancient Indian and Bengali traditions, the 'chhatra' (umbrella) symbolized royal authority and protection; its breaking signified the end of a ruler's power or the collapse of a kingdom.
note: This idiom draws from historical symbols of kingship prevalent in South Asian culture.
